mapper.select:
select chatbot_seq, question, answer, category, activity, region, food from ( select chatbot_seq, question, answer, category, activity, region, food from chatbot where
instr(lower(nvl(question, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(nvl(answer, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(nvl(category, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(nvl(activity, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(nvl(region, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 or instr(lower(nvl(food, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0
order by (
case when instr(lower(nvl(question, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 then 3 when instr(lower(nvl(category, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 then 2 when instr(lower(nvl(activity, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 then 2 when instr(lower(nvl(answer, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 then 1 when instr(lower(nvl(region, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 then 1 when instr(lower(nvl(food, ' ')), lower(#{keyword})) > 0 then 1 else 0 end
) desc, chatbot_seq desc ) where rownum <=7
